newsitem.title: CHINA: China Shenbao to make bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: China Shenbao to make bonus issue.

text.p: China beverage maker Shenzhen Shenbao Industrial Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would make a two-for-10 bonus issue based on 1996 profits and capital reserves.
The registration deadline is July 14 and the firm's A and B shares will go ex-dividend on July 15, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Bonus B shares will be listed on July 18 and bonus A shares on July 17, the statement said.
The company, which has a venture with PepsiCo, posted net profits of 42.96 million yuan for 1996 against 3.62 million yuan in 1995 under Chinese accounting standards.
Under international standards, Shenbao posted net earnings of 48.37 million yuan last year. It did not give a comparative figure.
